swords.about: The King of Swords represents clear thought, truth and fair judgment. His sword symbolizes the ability to separate facts from assumptions and use knowledge responsibly.
swords.upright: Clarity, integrity and disciplined thinking. Consider the evidence, communicate directly and make decisions that balance reason with fairness.
swords.reversed: Rigid thinking, harsh words or misuse of authority. Reflect on whether the need to be right is preventing you from listening to others.
swords.love: Encourages honest communication and clear boundaries. Make room for warmth and empathy alongside logic when discussing your needs.
swords.career: Invites careful planning, professional integrity and objective judgment. Seek informed advice and explain your decisions clearly.
swords.advice: Pause, check the facts and speak with honesty and kindness. Use this symbolism as a reflection prompt, not a prediction or a substitute for professional advice.

hangedMan.about: The Hanged Man represents a deliberate pause and a change of perspective. His suspended position symbolizes letting go of familiar approaches to see something differently.
hangedMan.upright: Patience, acceptance and a fresh viewpoint. A pause can help you recognize possibilities that urgency has hidden.
hangedMan.reversed: Resistance to change, unnecessary delay or feeling stuck. Consider whether you need more time to reflect or a small practical step forward.
hangedMan.love: Invites patience and seeing a situation from your partner's perspective. Reflect on what you can release without giving up your needs or boundaries.
hangedMan.career: Suggests reviewing priorities and approaching a stalled project differently. Take time to learn before making a considered next move.
hangedMan.advice: Give yourself space to look at the situation differently, then choose a thoughtful step. Use this symbolism for reflection rather than as a prediction.

swords.general: A pause is asking you to let go of control and see your situation from a new perspective
swords.past: You spent a long time chasing something that was never within reach
swords.present: You are still searching, but the answer may not be where you are looking
swords.future: Letting go of this search will open a new path for you

aries.description: The first sign of the zodiac, Aries is associated with strong energy and a pioneering spirit. It represents new beginnings, courage and initiative. Aries is often described as independent and ambitious, ready to face a challenge.
aries.love: Aries is traditionally passionate, honest and devoted in love. They seek a strong, independent partner who shares their adventures and encourages their growth.

taurus.description: Taurus is associated with stability, patience and an appreciation of beauty. This earth sign values comfort and steady progress, approaching its goals with practical determination.
taurus.love: Taurus values trust, affection and lasting commitment. They often express love through thoughtful actions and seek a reliable partner who appreciates a peaceful life together.

gemini.description: Gemini is associated with curiosity, communication and a lively mind. This air sign enjoys exchanging ideas, meeting people and exploring different perspectives.
gemini.love: Gemini seeks conversation, friendship and variety in a relationship. They appreciate a curious partner who shares new experiences while respecting their independence.

cancer.description: Cancer is associated with sensitivity, intuition and close emotional bonds. This water sign values home and belonging, often caring deeply for the people around it.
cancer.love: Cancer seeks emotional safety, tenderness and loyalty. They build closeness through care and appreciate a partner who communicates kindly and consistently.

leo.description: Leo is associated with warmth, confidence and creative expression. This fire sign enjoys inspiring others and brings generosity and enthusiasm to its pursuits.
leo.love: Leo is warm, expressive and generous in love. They appreciate mutual admiration, loyalty and a partner who celebrates their individuality.

virgo.description: Virgo is associated with thoughtful analysis, organization and practical service. This earth sign notices details and seeks to make everyday life more useful and harmonious.
virgo.love: Virgo often shows affection through support and thoughtful details. They value honesty and reliability, thriving with a partner who appreciates their care without expecting perfection.

libra.description: Libra is associated with balance, fairness and cooperation. This air sign values beauty and connection, seeking to understand different viewpoints and create harmony.
libra.love: Libra values companionship, romance and mutual respect. They seek a considerate partner who shares decisions openly and helps maintain a balanced relationship.

scorpio.description: Scorpio is associated with emotional depth, determination and transformation. This water sign seeks meaning beneath the surface and approaches important bonds with intensity.
scorpio.love: Scorpio values deep trust and emotional honesty. They tend to seek a devoted partner who respects their privacy while building a secure, open connection.

sagittarius.description: Sagittarius is associated with exploration, optimism and a search for meaning. This fire sign enjoys learning, travel and the freedom to discover new possibilities.
sagittarius.love: Sagittarius seeks honesty, laughter and shared adventure. They appreciate a partner who encourages growth and balances closeness with personal freedom.

capricorn.description: Capricorn is associated with responsibility, ambition and patient effort. This earth sign values structure and works steadily toward long-term goals.
capricorn.love: Capricorn builds love through consistency, loyalty and shared plans. They appreciate a dependable partner who makes room for both ambition and emotional warmth.

aquarius.description: Aquarius is associated with originality, independence and collective progress. This air sign enjoys unconventional ideas and finding new ways to support its community.
aquarius.love: Aquarius values friendship, intellectual connection and individuality. They seek an open-minded partner who respects their freedom and shares their hopes for the future.

pisces.description: Pisces is associated with compassion, imagination and intuition. This water sign is often drawn to creativity and the emotional experiences that connect people.
pisces.love: Pisces seeks tenderness, understanding and a meaningful emotional bond. They appreciate a caring partner who supports their dreams while encouraging healthy boundaries.
